_comment: Career Decision Board — the single config file. Everything the engine needs to know about YOUR job search lives here. No code changes required to adapt the board to a new user, new labels, or new keywords.

sectors._comment: Optional: map exact company names to sectors for the Insights tab. Anything unmapped shows as 'Other'. Add your own as you go.

email_events._comment: Keyword rules that classify a scanned email into an event. First match wins, in the order below.
rejection: decided to move forward with other

gmail._comment: Gmail API scan settings. Queries use Gmail search syntax; each is combined with after:START_DATE at scan time.
gmail._skip_comment: Newsletter / marketing senders to ignore unless they clearly confirm an application or interview.

queries.application_confirmations: subject:("thank you for applying" OR "application received" OR "we received your application" OR "application confirmation" OR "successfully applied" OR "thank you for your application" OR "application has been submitted")
queries.ats_senders: from:(greenhouse-mail.io OR greenhouse.io OR lever.co OR myworkday.com OR ashbyhq.com OR bamboohr.com OR smartrecruiters.com OR rippling.com OR workablemail.com OR jobvite.com OR icims.com OR successfactors.com OR applytojob.com OR taleo.net)
queries.interviews: subject:("interview" OR "phone screen" OR "technical screen" OR "next steps" OR "we would like to schedule" OR "assessment" OR "hiring manager" OR "move forward" OR "quick connect" OR "offer")
queries.job_alerts: from:(jobalerts-noreply@linkedin.com OR jobs-noreply@linkedin.com OR noreply@indeed.com OR alert@indeed.com) subject:(job OR role OR hiring OR alert OR "new jobs")
queries.rejections: subject:("unfortunately" OR "not moving forward" OR "other candidates" OR "not selected" OR "decided not to" OR "update on your application" OR "your application with")
